clock_semantics: Estimates matched to previous post-truth only if sensor_time agrees within1e-7s. Halfsecond bins refer to command times; post truth is one control interval later.
unknowns: Missing original IMU/encoder/wheel-rate packet remains UNKNOWN; estimated leg q/qd not a replacement for raw or2k actual shaft rates.
Last-substep applied torque is not2k torque history/DC clipping occupancy.
No slip classification without wheel rolling/contact-velocity evidence; no contact_trace consumed.
Shaper/park-integral/active-reference and balance-versus-speed torque split unknown unless explicitly present in additional_logged_fields.
minimal_additional_logging: Same sensor-epoch packet wheel_vel2/joint_pos4/joint_vel4/raw_gyro plus source timestamp and age; keep estimated_vx/yaw.
Controller shaped v and active forward-speed/position references, park integral and wheel balance/speed/braking decomposition at each command.
Offline-only actual wheel shaft rates at root-velocity grading time, and actual20substep torque min/max/clip counts; not new truth inputs to controller.
